data.one_liner: Widget that aligns, positions, sizes, rotates and transforms a child relative to its container.
data.what_it_does: Provides AlignPositioned, AnimatedAlignPositioned and AnimChain widgets to declaratively control a child’s alignment, offset, size and rotation. Supports RTL, explicit and implicit animations.
use_when: Complex layouts that are hard to achieve with Rows/Columns
Need precise pixel or relative positioning with animation
avoid_when: Simple layouts that can be built with standard Flutter widgets
Performance‑critical UI where extra layout calculations may add overhead
strengths: Fine‑grained control over position, size and rotation
Built‑in support for explicit and implicit animations
weaknesses: Adds another layer of abstraction that may increase widget tree complexity
Limited to positioning; does not provide higher‑level UI components
May require learning new parameter set
data.minimal_example:
AlignPositioned(
  child: MyWidget(),
  alignment: Alignment.topLeft,
  dx: 15.0,
  moveByChildWidth: -0.5,
  moveByChildHeight: -0.5,
);
